colors.name: Microsoft Blue
colors.role: Primary action background, link text, navigation accents, icon strokes - the single chromatic authority in the system, used for all filled CTAs and interactive highlights

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Page background, card surfaces, button text on blue, surface elevation

colors.name: Mist Gray
colors.role: Footer background, subtle surface tone, page canvas under cards

colors.name: Carbon Black
colors.role: Primary text, card borders, hairline dividers - the dominant typographic and structural color

colors.name: Steel Gray
colors.role: Secondary text, navigation text, muted UI elements, footer copy

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Body text variant, list borders, navigation dividers, secondary headings

colors.name: Deep Charcoal
colors.role: Dense text blocks, list separators, button border variant - the darkest neutral after pure black

fonts.name: Segoe UI
fonts.role: Sole typeface across the entire system - navigation, body, headings, buttons, footer. Weight 400 is the workhorse; weight 600 is reserved for headings and button labels to create section-level contrast without switching families. Segoe UI's humanist proportions and open apertures give the system its calm, enterprise-confident voice - the type does not perform, it informs.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.role: Filled CTA used for 'Comprar ahora', 'Descargar ahora', 'Unirse ahora', 'Mas informacion'

components.name: Ghost Text Link
components.role: Inline links in navigation rows, card text links, footer links

components.name: Product Card
components.role: Grid card for Surface, Xbox, accessories, and software promotions

components.name: Hero Card Overlay
components.role: White text card layered over a blue photographic hero

components.name: Category Icon Link
components.role: Icon + label links for 'Comprar portatiles Surface', 'Comprar consolas y juegos para Xbox', etc.

components.name: Top Navigation Bar
components.role: Sticky header with Microsoft logo, product links, and account controls

components.name: Hero Banner
components.role: Full-width promotional section with product or lifestyle photography

components.name: Feature Band
components.role: Full-width promotional section (e.g., Microsoft Edge, AI for Earth)

components.name: Section Heading Group
components.role: Text block above a card grid or content row

components.name: Footer
components.role: Site-wide footer with links and legal

do: Use #0067b8 as the sole chromatic color for all filled action buttons, link text, and active navigation indicators
Set button border-radius to 2px - subtle rounding, not pill-shaped
Apply the card shadow stack (rgba(0,0,0,0.13) 0 3px 7px + rgba(0,0,0,0.11) 0 1px 2px) only to product cards in grids
Use Segoe UI weight 600 for headings, card titles, and button labels; weight 400 for all body, nav, and link text
Maintain 8px as the base spacing unit - use 8/16/24/48px steps for padding, margins, and gaps
Layer white overlay cards (32-48px padding, no border) over full-bleed hero photography for text legibility
Keep card grids at 4 equal columns with 16-24px gaps inside a max-width 1200px container
doNot: Do not introduce additional brand colors - the system is monochrome plus #0067b8
Do not use border-radius greater than 2px on buttons, inputs, or cards - keep edges nearly sharp
Do not apply shadows to navigation bars, buttons, or text blocks - only to product cards
Do not use Segoe UI weights other than 400 and 600 - no 300 whisper-weights or 700 bold declarations
Do not create outlined or ghost button variants - all actions are filled blue or simple text links
Do not add decorative gradients - the system relies on photography and flat surfaces
Do not use fully saturated icons - category icons should be 1.5-2px stroke outline style in #616161 or #000000
